topic: Implementing Deep Copy Semantics with Function Pointers and Custom Copy Functions
explanation: In advanced C programming, managing complex data structures that contain pointers requires implementing custom deep copy mechanisms to avoid shallow copying pitfalls. This involves designing functions that perform deep copies of nested data, often utilizing function pointers to allow flexible copying strategies, especially when dealing with polymorphic or variable data types within structures. Properly implementing these techniques ensures data integrity, prevents dangling pointers, and facilitates safe copying of complex objects in systems programming, libraries, or resource management scenarios.
keywords: C deep copy function pointer, polymorphic deep copy C, custom struct copy function, generic deep copy C
